basic_info.description: Located in the heart of San Francisco's prestigious Nob Hill neighborhood, 1380 Washington Street offers timeless 1908 architecture combined with strong in-place income. This well-maintained building consists of eight (8) one-bedroom, one-bath units, totaling 5,004 square feet of rentable space. With separate PG&E meters, steam heat and no soft-story retrofit requirement, the asset provides low-maintenance infrastructure and long-term stability.   Current Scheduled Gross Income: $217,301/year  Current CAP Rate: 5.5%, Pro Forma CAP Rate: 7.66%. GRM: 11.04, $300,000/unit, $480/ft.
